title: Open-UniMo: Towards Unified Motion-Language Understanding and Generation in the Open World
abstract: arXiv:2609.14615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified motion generation and understanding is crucial for embodied AI systems that can both synthesize and interpret human actions in open-world environments. Existing motion-language models often treat motion as an auxiliary modality of a language model, leading to text-dominated representations and limited cross-modal interaction. Moreover, the next-token prediction paradigm is not naturally suited to long motion sequences, where autoregressive generation may accumulate prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose Open-UniMo, a unified Large Motion-Language Model (LMLM) trained on million-scale open-world motion-language data. Open-UniMo promotes modality parity by extending Qwen's vocabulary of about 150K text tokens with 64K motion tokens, enabling motion and language to share a unified token space. We further introduce motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an intermediate representation to bridge language

translated_title: Open-UniMo：迈向开放世界中统一的动作-语言理解与生成
translated_abstract: 统一的动作生成与理解对于能够在开放世界环境中同时合成和解释人类动作的具身AI系统至关重要。现有的动作-语言模型通常将动作视为语言模型的辅助模态，导致文本主导的表示以及有限的跨模态交互。此外，下一个词预测范式并不天然适合长动作序列，自回归生成可能会累积预测误差。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Open-UniMo，这是一个在百万级开放世界动作-语言数据上训练的统一大型动作-语言模型（LMLM）。Open-UniMo通过在Qwen约15万个文本token词表的基础上扩展6.4万个动作token来促进模态平等，使动作和语言共享统一的token空间。我们进一步引入动作一致的思维链推理作为中间表示，以桥接语言与动作……
tldr: 提出了统一大型动作-语言模型Open-UniMo，通过扩展词表使动作与语言共享统一token空间以实现模态平等，并引入动作一致的思维链推理，从而在开放世界中实现动作-语言的统一理解与生成。
en_tdlr: Open-UniMo is a unified Large Motion-Language Model that achieves modality parity by sharing a unified token space between motion and language tokens and introduces motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning, enabling unified motion-language understanding and generation in the open world.
